title: Navimower 0.4.4-beta13

## X3 RTK map anchor

- Use the X3 `RTK_anchor` map-detail value as the authoritative WGS84 translation for local map coordinate `(0, 0)` when the X3 RTK metadata is present and valid.
- Keep rotation and scale evidence from the internally consistent static vendor map ties, so this change corrects absolute translation without distorting the map.
- Preserve the beta12 i1 `vendor_map_static_fit` path unchanged when no X3 RTK metadata exists.
- Preserve the existing H2 explicit `map_north_offset` path unchanged.
- Keep cloud-location fitting as an independent validation/diagnostic signal instead of allowing live cloud GPS drift to move the X3 map.
- Expose RTK anchor translation, parsed LRTK pile values and NRTK/LRTK bias metadata in georeference diagnostics.
- Force one map-detail refresh for persisted beta12 static-map caches so X3 installations can discover `RTK_anchor` automatically after update.

The captured X390 map shows `RTK_anchor` about 5.4 m from `origin_gps` in the same direction as the observed OSM placement error, while the static map fit already has near-unit scale and near-zero rotation. This beta tests that RTK origin as the missing absolute X3 anchor.
